phase: Phase 1 - Data Acquisition, Dataset Analysis & Unified Dataset Construction

datasets.selection_rationale: Perfect balanced panel dataset with 73,100 daily records across 5 stores and 20 products for 731 continuous days (2022-01-01 to 2024-01-01). Contains real units sold, unit prices, discounts, promotion flags, weather, and competitor prices.

Contains 99,457 retail invoice records from Istanbul shopping malls (2021-2023). However, it lacks product-level identifiers (only category names) and store identifiers are distinct Turkish shopping malls. Cannot be joined with SKU-level retail store panel without fabricating fake identifiers.

UCI Machine Learning Online Retail dataset containing 541,909 giftware transactions from 2010 to 2011 in the UK. Timeframe (2010-2011) does not overlap with 2022-2024 panel, and product catalog (StockCodes) and non-store structure are incompatible with physical retail stores.

Montgomery County Maryland Department of Liquor Control dataset containing 341,037 monthly liquor warehouse and retail transfer records across only 4 calendar months (2020-06 to 2020-09). Incompatible granularity (monthly vs daily) and domain (county liquor monopoly vs retail products).

Customer demographic purchase log with 4,310 transaction rows across Indian cities from 2020 to 2024. Product names are generic ('Sugar', 'T-shirt') and no store IDs exist. Extremely sparse (1-2 records per day nationally). Cannot be joined with SKU-store panel.

Australian B2B commercial office supplies and furniture order log with 5,000 rows spanning 2013-2017. Outdated timeframe, B2B wholesale granularity, and distinct Australian geography make it incompatible with the primary dataset.

Amazon India consumer electronics and home accessories product catalog with 1,465 reviews and rating metrics. Has no sales volume, no store dimension, no time-series timestamps, and uses Amazon ASIN identifiers rather than retail SKUs.
Static e-commerce cross-marketplace MRP pricing comparison matrix for 1,330 Indian ethnic wear SKUs in March 2021. Contains no time series, no demand figures, and no physical store dimensions.

Small e-commerce transactional dataset with 1,194 orders across 18 US cities (2020-2025). Lacks SKU identifiers (only 12 sub-categories) and physical store IDs. Transactions are too sparse for continuous time-series modeling.

Small B2B enterprise sales log with 1,000 order transactions logged by 5 sales reps in 2023. Contains numeric Product_IDs (1001-1100), but has no store IDs and sparse transactions per product (approx. 10 transactions per product across an entire year).
